text:
oncall-bot: ALERT at 14:03 UTC - inference-runtime: increased 502s and rpc_timeout counts in us-west & eu-west. PD escalation for SLO-High. auto-escalation engaged.

jared: I'm on it. seeing repeated traces: `kv-cache eviction failed` + `worker send timeout`. looks like cache churn. spike from one customer shard in logs.

maya: confirmed with a small replay. a cohort is sending very long sequences, causing KV churn and queuing. might be a rogue A/B.

ali: rolling a short-lived routing tweak: group by `customer_id` and apply a 5/min rate cap for the noisy alert to cut duplicates. keeping prod pages for severity-high. :lock:

jen: good call. can we also put an alert-forwarding rate limiter at the PD integration level? propose 5 pages/min per customer during incident.

jared: adding an emergency fallback: route that customer's traffic to a degraded model variant to reduce latency while we debug.

liz: product check - 3 customers impacted, 1 SLA customer reported bad UX. notifying CS/AMs now.

maya: mitigation I tested locally:
```
# alertmanager emergency snippet
route:
  group_by: ["customer_id","alertname"]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 1h
squelch_policy:
  per_customer_rate: 5/min
  apply_to: ["inference-runtime-high-error"]
```

ali: applying scoped change to Alertmanager + routing for 30m. deploying now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by ali -> ton/alert-routing emergency/2026-03-15

jared: spinning up a temp dashboard widget: `errors by customer`, `median latency`, `p95/p99 latency` to triage quickly.

jen: I'll add a quick canary probe hitting the fallback model to validate degraded path.

maya: replay filtered to suspected cohort: >70% of requests exceed expected seq distribution. clear anomaly.

liz: customer note drafted: "Temporarily mitigated increased inference errors caused by long requests; working on permanent fix." tagging AMs.

ali: change is live. routing now groups and limits duplicates; suppressed ~78 PD duplicates so far. watching.

oncall-bot: CHANGE applied by ali at 14:18 UTC - routing updated. 78 duplicate incidents suppressed; notifications now consolidated to thread only.

jared: noise down to reasonable levels. still need RCA + decide permanent tuning.

maya: root cause hypothesis: client-side A/B sends repeating long prompts causing KV thrash. remediation options:
- ask client to chunk requests
- increase KV cache for that customer pool only
- server-side soft rejection above threshold (clear 413/429)

jen: ops caution: don't bump global KV cache w/o testing. prefer targeted pool bump or server-side token limit.

ali: prepping dedicated worker pool with larger KV as stopgap if client can't fix quickly.

liz: PM path: coordinate with AMs to pause test; escalate to legal if SLA breach risk.

jared: follow-ups assigned:
- maya: full postmortem with replay artifacts
- ali: codify scoped dedupe/grouping/rate-limit changes into runbooks
- jen: add canary probe + synthetic tests
- liz: customer comms + SLA tracking

maya: postmortem stub: https://company.internal/postmortems/inf-noise-2387654321 (adding traces & repro)

jen: suggestion for permanent routing: hybrid group key: `customer_id|model_variant|region` + default per-customer rate caps. will draft migration plan.

ali: proposal: add an 'emergency squelch' button in Console to apply dedupe shields for a window that auto-expires. low friction for oncall.

jared: +1 - makes live mitigation faster, less ops friction.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: temporary squelch auto-expires in 30m. Manual cancel: `/oncall cancel-squelch 2387654321`

liz: I'll post a short summary to #engineering and loop CS/AMs. schedule a tuning session next week for thresholds + dashboard templates.

ali: leaving the temporary config in place for now; will close after 22m unless we extend. capturing metrics for rollback test.

jared: please add logs/traces to postmortem doc. target: RCA + remediation plan by EOD.

maya: adding minimal repro script & traces to the doc now.

jen: will open PR for canary job today.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded -> ton/alert-routing emergency/2026-03-15 (finished)

oncall-bot: THREAD CLOSED at 14:39 UTC - follow-ups assigned. If new triggers occur, start a fresh thread and reference 2387654321
